name: Restaurant
description: A named place whose primary purpose is serving prepared meals. This includes a bar, taberna, or pintxo bar when the recommendation centers on its food and no drink program is the main draw. Use Café for coffee-led places and Bakery for bread or pastry-led places.

name: Café
description: A coffee shop, tea shop, or café where drinks and light food are central, even when it also serves meals.

name: Cocktail Bar
description: A bar or lounge where drinking, cocktails, or mixed drinks are the main draw. When the source only says bar, use Cocktail Bar only when it is presented primarily as a drinking or nightlife destination; use Restaurant when the recommendation centers on food.

name: Club
description: A nightclub or dance club where DJs, dancing, amplified music, and nightlife are the main draw. Do not use it for a one-off Concert.

name: Wine Bar
description: A bar primarily centered on wine, wine flights, or a wine-focused drinking experience.

name: Pub
description: A pub, taproom, or beer-led bar where beer, ale, or pints are directly evidenced as the main drinking experience. Do not use Pub for a generic bar, taberna, or pintxo bar merely because it is called a bar.

name: Bakery
description: A bakery, pastry shop, bread shop, or dessert shop whose baked goods are the main draw. Use Café when coffee or café service is the clearer focus.

name: Museum
description: A museum as an institution or place. Use Exhibit for a specific exhibition, installation, or curated show inside it.

name: Art Gallery
description: An art gallery as a standing venue or organization. Use Exhibit for a specific exhibition, installation, or curated show.

name: Furniture Store
description: A store primarily selling furniture, home furnishings, or large interior pieces.

name: Clothes Store
description: A clothing-led retailer, boutique, menswear shop, tailor, or apparel-focused thrift shop.

name: Health and Beauty Store
description: A retailer primarily selling skincare, cosmetics, grooming, personal care, or health and beauty goods. Use Spa for services and treatments.

name: Misc. Store
description: A physical retailer that does not fit Furniture Store, Clothes Store, or Health and Beauty Store, including antique, specialty food, hobby, and general-goods shops.

name: Spa
description: A spa, salon, wellness studio, or place primarily offering beauty, relaxation, or personal-care services rather than selling goods.

name: Park
description: A park, garden, green space, or named outdoor public area. Use Hiking Trail or Bike Route when the route itself is the recommendation.

name: Movie Theater
description: A physical cinema, repertory theater, drive-in, or movie theater as a place. Use Movie for a film as a creative work.

name: Bike Route
description: A cycling route, bike path, or ride whose course is the recommendation, whether or not it resolves to one map point.

name: Hiking Trail
description: A hiking trail, walking trail, or hike whose route is the recommendation, whether or not it resolves to one map point.

name: Fitness
description: A gym, fitness studio, workout, class, training program, or other exercise-focused recommendation.

name: Concert
description: A specific live music performance, concert, or music festival. Use Club for a standing nightlife venue rather than a particular performance.

name: Pop-up
description: A temporary or limited-run food, retail, service, or event offering that is not better classified as a Concert or Exhibit.

name: Exhibit
description: A specific exhibition, installation, or curated show. Use Museum or Art Gallery for the standing institution or venue itself.

name: Book
description: A book as a creative work. An author or other person is not a Book.

name: Movie
description: A film as a creative work, not a physical cinema. A filmmaker, director, or other person is not a Movie.

name: Article
description: A specific written article, essay, or published web story. An author or other person is not an Article.

name: Song
description: A specific song or musical recording. A musician or other person is not a Song.

name: Product
description: A specific product or non-location item offered for use or purchase that is not one of the dedicated creative-work types.

name: Unknown
description: A valid save-worthy recommendation that fits none of the listed types, including a person or creator when no dedicated person type exists. Unknown may still have a location.
